title: We are pleased to announce the new ESv2 Embedded Application from Vertiv
summary: This application is a new industry standard which manages devices and infrastructure from the Edge to the Cloud. The next generation ESv2 is a suite of applications and tools that simplifies and accelerates design, development and deployment of embedded control devices for managing and monitoring IoT and IT infrastructure.
